Good morning,

I hope you are doing well.

We would like to kindly inform you that the property owner has requested a brief viewing of the apartment today.

Would it be possible to accommodate the viewing at 2:00 PM? If this time is convenient for you, kindly confirm so we can inform the owner and coordinate accordingly.

The viewing will be brief, and we truly appreciate your kind cooperation and understanding.

Thank you in advance.
